decisions.reason: A waterproof lined safety range sits close to the core offer, so keeping it costs little, and the missing 2020-2021 archive pages reveal nothing negative about its value, so the option stays open.
Electrostatic-dissipative occupational shoes serve steady industrial demand and share the firm's existing production and channels, so there is no evidence to justify abandoning this low-cost option.

A safety shoe series is core business with low holding cost, and although series may be refreshed in a broad assortment, nothing so far shows its value is unlikely to be realized, so keeping it is warranted.
